name: PM MUDRA Yojana — Shishu
description: Micro-loans up to ₹50,000 for starting or early-stage businesses. Covers all non-farm income generating activities.
descriptionHi: नए या शुरुआती व्यवसायों के लिए ₹50,000 तक का ऋण।

eligibility.otherCriteria: Indian citizen, non-farm business activity, no existing default

benefits.description: Collateral-free loan up to ₹50,000 for business startup or expansion

name: PM MUDRA Yojana — Kishore
description: Loans from ₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh for growing businesses. Suitable for working capital and asset purchase.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Existing business with growth plans, no existing default

benefits.description: Collateral-free business loan from ₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh

name: PM MUDRA Yojana — Tarun
description: Loans from ₹5 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh for established micro/small businesses for expansion.

benefits.description: Loan from ₹5 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh for business expansion

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors. Subsidy 15-35% depending on category and location.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Age above 18 years, minimum VIII standard pass for projects above ₹10 Lakh (manufacturing) and ₹5 Lakh (service)

benefits.description: 15% subsidy for general category in urban areas; 25% for rural; 25-35% for special categories (SC/ST/OBC/Women/ex-servicemen/minorities/PH/NE region/Hill districts)
Project cost up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 Lakh for service

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
nameHi: सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यमों के लिए क्रेडिट गारंटी ट्रस्ट
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of MSME
description: Provides credit guarantee up to 85% coverage for loans to micro and small enterprises without collateral.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Udyam Registration required, new or existing business

benefits.description: Credit guarantee coverage of 75-85% of loan amount, enabling collateral-free lending

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Holistic support scheme for artisans and craftspeople from 18 traditional trades. Includes recognition, skill training, toolkit support, credit access, and market linkage.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Must belong to one of 18 specified crafts (Blacksmith, Goldsmith, Potter, Carpenter, Tailor, etc.)

benefits.description: ₹15,000 toolkit support (upfront after skill training)
Collateral-free credit: ₹1 Lakh (Stage 1), ₹2 Lakh (Stage 2) at 5% concessional rate
Basic (5-7 days) and advanced (15 days) skill training with ₹500/day stipend

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services or trading sector for SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs.

eligibility.otherCriteria: At least one SC/ST or woman borrower per bank branch, greenfield project

benefits.description: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore covering up to 75% of project cost

name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
nameHi: पारंपरिक उद्योगों के पुनरुद्धार के लिए योजना
description: Organizes traditional industries and artisans into clusters to make them competitive and self-sustaining. Provides infrastructure support.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Traditional industries like Khadi, Coir, Bamboo, Honey, Pottery etc.

benefits.description: Soft intervention ₹25 Lakh per cluster; Hard intervention ₹1.5 Crore; Major intervention ₹2.5 Crore

name: Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) Certification
description: Quality certification for MSME products with subsidy up to 80% for the certification fee. Boosts quality and competitiveness for domestic and export markets.

benefits.description: Subsidy on certification fee: 80% for micro, 60% for small, 50% for medium enterprises

name: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (CLCSS)
description: 15% capital subsidy for technology upgradation for small enterprises in manufacturing. Helps upgrade to state-of-the-art technology.

benefits.description: 15% upfront capital subsidy on institutional credit for technology upgradation, maximum subsidy ₹15 Lakh

name: Design Clinic Scheme
description: Brings design expertise to MSME manufacturing clusters to improve product design, reduce costs and improve marketability.

benefits.description: Subsidy of 75% on design project costs for micro enterprises, 60% for small/medium (max ₹40 Lakh per project)

name: Startup India — DPIIT Recognition & Benefits
description: Official DPIIT recognition unlocks multiple benefits: income tax exemption for 3 years, fast-track patent filing (80% fee rebate), self-certification for labour laws, government tender exemptions.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Incorporated <10 years ago, annual turnover <₹100 Crore, working on innovative product/service

benefits.description: Income tax exemption for 3 consecutive years under 80-IAC
80% rebate on patent filing fees
Exemption from prior experience/turnover criteria for government tenders

name: NSIC — Raw Material Assistance
description: Helps MSMEs procure raw materials on easy credit terms. NSIC acts as facilitator for bulk procurement discounts.

benefits.description: Working capital credit for raw material procurement with 3-6 month credit period, financing up to 75% of cost

name: MSME Champions Scheme
description: Cluster development scheme to upgrade MSMEs through Competitive, Lean, Digital, Quality and Sustainable interventions.

benefits.description: Subsidized consultancy and intervention services for lean manufacturing, digital transformation, quality and sustainability

name: A Scheme for Promoting Innovation, Rural Industries & Entrepreneurship (ASPIRE)
description: Sets up technology business incubators and livelihood business incubators in rural areas to promote innovation in agro-industries.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Rural entrepreneurs, focus on agro-based businesses

benefits.description: Setting up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBI) with ₹1 Crore support per incubator and Technology Business Incubators (TBI) with ₹5 Crore support
Skill training and mentorship for rural entrepreneurs

name: PLI Scheme for Textiles — MMF Apparel & Technical Textiles
nameHi: वस्त्र उद्योग के लिए PLI योजना
description: Production Linked Incentive for manufacturing Man-Made Fibre (MMF) apparel, MMF fabrics, and technical textiles. Incentive of 15% for first 2 years, 11% for next 3 years.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Minimum investment of ₹30 Crore for MMF apparel; turnover growth benchmark

benefits.description: Production Linked Incentive: 15% on incremental turnover (year 1-2), 11% (year 3-5), 8-3% (year 6-10). Total outlay ₹10,683 Crore.

name: PLI Scheme for Food Processing Industry
nameHi: खाद्य प्रसंस्करण के लिए PLI योजना
description: Production Linked Incentive to boost food manufacturing and create global champions. Covers Ready-to-Cook, Ready-to-Eat, marine products, mozzarella cheese etc.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Minimum sales threshold varies by category

benefits.description: Incentive of 10% on incremental sales over base year for first 2 years, reducing to 3% by year 6. Total outlay ₹10,900 Crore.

name: SIDBI Direct Lending — MSME Loans
description: SIDBI's direct lending programs for MSMEs including term loans for capacity expansion, equipment finance, and working capital.

benefits.description: Term loans and working capital from ₹10 Lakh to ₹25 Crore at competitive rates (8.5-13% depending on risk profile)

name: SAMRIDH — Startup Accelerators of MeiTY for Product Innovation and Development
description: Provides funding up to ₹40 Lakh per startup and connects to investors for IT/tech MSMEs and startups.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Technology startup with functional product/prototype, incorporated <10 years

benefits.description: Funding up to ₹40 Lakh per startup + investor network access + mentorship

name: Digital MSME Scheme
description: Promotes digital transformation of MSMEs through subsidized cloud computing adoption, digital payments, e-commerce integration and digital marketing.

benefits.description: Subsidy of 45-75% on cloud subscription costs (ICT tools) for 3 years. Micro: 75%, Small: 60%, Medium: 45%
